Extended Relational Model (3NF/BCNF) • Strong (Solid) vs. Weak (Broken) Relationship Semantics & Non-Intertwining Orthogonal Bus Routing
Child entity cannot exist without parent. Foreign Key is mandatory. Enforces ON DELETE CASCADE.
Child entity possesses independent identity. Foreign Key is optional/nullable. Enforces ON DELETE SET NULL.
